title: Menu Core menu file
description: A menu file of @amxts/menu-core: chatPrefix, labels and menus.

chatPrefix.markdownDescription: The chat prefix of Menu Core's messages (the "nothing to list" message). INI: `[MAIN]` `PREFIX`.
chatPrefix.description: The chat prefix of Menu Core's messages (the "nothing to list" message). INI: [MAIN] PREFIX.

labels.markdownDescription: The words of the buttons, the page and the countdown. INI: `[MAIN]` `KEY = { ... }`.
labels.description: The words of the buttons, the page and the countdown. INI: [MAIN] KEY = { ... }.

menus.markdownDescription: The menus: `{ NAME: menu }`; a name starting with `LIST_` is a list menu. INI: a `[NAME]` section each.
menus.description: The menus: { NAME: menu }; a name starting with LIST_ is a list menu. INI: a [NAME] section each.

exit.markdownDescription: The exit button. A lang key or the text itself.
exit.description: The exit button. A lang key or the text itself.

back.markdownDescription: The back button. A lang key or the text itself.
back.description: The back button. A lang key or the text itself.

next.markdownDescription: The next page button. A lang key or the text itself.
next.description: The next page button. A lang key or the text itself.

number.markdownDescription: The number before an item: `!y[%d]!w` unless the dictionary says otherwise.
number.description: The number before an item: !y[%d]!w unless the dictionary says otherwise.

disabled.markdownDescription: The number before a greyed-out item.
disabled.description: The number before a greyed-out item.

page.markdownDescription: The page counter. A lang key or the text itself.
page.description: The page counter. A lang key or the text itself.

time.markdownDescription: The countdown. A lang key or the text itself.
time.description: The countdown. A lang key or the text itself.

title.markdownDescription: The title; a menu has one. A lang key or the text itself. INI: `TITLE`.
title.description: The title; a menu has one. A lang key or the text itself. INI: TITLE.

activeOn.markdownDescription: Conditions the menu opens only under. INI: `ACTIVE_ON`.
activeOn.description: Conditions the menu opens only under. INI: ACTIVE_ON.

hideBack.markdownDescription: `true` leaves the back button out. INI: `HIDE_BACK`.
hideBack.description: true leaves the back button out. INI: HIDE_BACK.

hideExit.markdownDescription: `true` leaves the exit button out. INI: `HIDE_EXIT`.
hideExit.description: true leaves the exit button out. INI: HIDE_EXIT.

locked.markdownDescription: Items cannot be chosen, and the menu cannot be closed or replaced. INI: `LOCKED`.
locked.description: Items cannot be chosen, and the menu cannot be closed or replaced. INI: LOCKED.

sharedTimer.markdownDescription: One countdown for everyone who looks at the menu. INI: `GLOBAL`.
sharedTimer.description: One countdown for everyone who looks at the menu. INI: GLOBAL.

time.description: A countdown in seconds. INI: TIME.

onTimeout.markdownDescription: Actions run when the countdown ends. INI: `ON_TIMEOUT`.
onTimeout.description: Actions run when the countdown ends. INI: ON_TIMEOUT.

items.description: An items menu's items. INI: ITEMS.

fixedItems.markdownDescription: Items that keep their `slot`, 1-7, on every page. INI: `FIXED_ITEMS`.
fixedItems.description: Items that keep their slot, 1-7, on every page. INI: FIXED_ITEMS.

filters.markdownDescription: A list menu's filters: rows the `when` of one does not hold for are left out. INI: `FILTER`.
filters.description: A list menu's filters: rows the when of one does not hold for are left out. INI: FILTER.

view.markdownDescription: A list menu's row, drawn per player or per row of its list source. INI: `VIEW`.
view.description: A list menu's row, drawn per player or per row of its list source. INI: VIEW.

name.markdownDescription: The item's text. A lang key or the text itself.
name.description: The item's text. A lang key or the text itself.

action.markdownDescription: Actions run when the item is chosen: registered ones, `SHOW_<MENU>`, `CLOSE_MENU`.
action.description: Actions run when the item is chosen: registered ones, SHOW_<MENU>, CLOSE_MENU.

visible.markdownDescription: Whether the item is shown at all: while its names do not hold, it is left out and takes no slot (a fixed item leaves its slot blank). One name, several space-separated (all must hold), or a list of them; `!NAME` turns one around; `NAME:param` hands the test a parameter and takes the rest of the line, so it goes last. A name is a restriction or a condition. INI has nothing that hides an item.
visible.description: Whether the item is shown at all: while its names do not hold, it is left out and takes no slot (a fixed item leaves its slot blank). One name, several space-separated (all must hold), or a list of them; !NAME turns one around; NAME:param hands the test a parameter and takes the rest of the line, so it goes last. A name is a restriction or a condition. INI has nothing that hides an item.

enabled.markdownDescription: Whether the item can be chosen: while not, it is greyed out with `message` beside it. A line of names - one, several space-separated (all must hold), `!NAME` turns one around, `NAME:param` hands the test a parameter and goes last - or a list of requirements, each a line of names or `{ when, message }` with a message of its own; the first that fails gives its message. A name is a restriction or a condition. INI: the condition column greys an item out without a message, the restriction column with the message column.
enabled.description: Whether the item can be chosen: while not, it is greyed out with message beside it. A line of names - one, several space-separated (all must hold), !NAME turns one around, NAME:param hands the test a parameter and goes last - or a list of requirements, each a line of names or { when, message } with a message of its own; the first that fails gives its message. A name is a restriction or a condition. INI: the condition column greys an item out without a message, the restriction column with the message column.

message.markdownDescription: Beside the item while `enabled` greys it out, in place of the restriction's own message; a requirement's own `message` goes in place of this one.
message.description: Beside the item while enabled greys it out, in place of the restriction's own message; a requirement's own message goes in place of this one.

variants.markdownDescription: Several faces of the item: the first variant whose `when` holds is shown; when none does, the first, greyed out. INI: `A|B` in the name, condition and action columns.
variants.description: Several faces of the item: the first variant whose when holds is shown; when none does, the first, greyed out. INI: A|B in the name, condition and action columns.
